patch.value: Enforce genuine 100/100/100/100 source coverage in the release gate

The built-in Node coverage baseline for dist/index.js is 82.84% lines, 74.67% branches, and 92.19% functions. Add meaningful unit, integration, functional, and real-CLI tests for every reachable source path; exclude only generated or non-source artifacts with documented justification. Enforce 100% lines, branches, functions, and statements in release:check without ignore pragmas, artificial calls, or coverage manipulation.

A deterministic coverage command reports 100% lines, branches, functions, and statements for all source files; release:check fails when any source coverage dimension drops below 100%; Tests exercise observable behavior and real failure paths without coverage-only branches, mocks that bypass production behavior, ignore pragmas, or generated-code inflation; Coverage execution uses the project-local latest pm CLI and is stable in npm and bun workflows
